description_en: Queries the status and extraction result of a dark watermark extraction task
description_zh: 查询暗水印提取任务的状态和提取结果
name: GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult

parameters.help_en: A reserved idempotence field. This field is not supported. Passing in a value does not cause an error, but it does not produce an idempotence effect
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等字段，暂不支持。传入不会报错，但当前不产生幂等效果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The dark watermark task ID returned by the CreateWatermarkExtractTask operation
parameters.help_zh: 暗水印任务 ID，由 CreateWatermarkExtractTask 接口返回
parameters.name: task_id

AvgAcc.description_en: The average extraction confidence, ranging from 0 to 1. This parameter is returned only when Status is succeeded
AvgAcc.description_zh: 平均提取置信度，范围 0~1。仅在 Status 为 succeeded 时返回

Code.description_en: The business error code. OK is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

Detected.description_en: Indicates whether a watermark is detected

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. 200 is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The failure reason when the task fails. This parameter is returned only when Status is failed
Message.description_zh: 任务失败时的失败原因。仅在 Status 为 failed 时返回
Message.example: The request has failed due to a temporary failure of the server.
Message.title_en: 任务失败时的错误信息
Message.title_zh: 任务失败时的错误信息

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
running: In progress.
succeeded: Completed.
failed: Failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
running（执行中）
succeeded（已完成）
failed（失败）
Status.title_en: 任务状态，取值：pending（等待中）、running（执行中）、succeeded（成功）、failed（失败）；处理耗时约与媒体时长相当
Status.title_zh: 任务状态，取值：pending（等待中）、running（执行中）、succeeded（成功）、failed（失败）；处理耗时约与媒体时长相当

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The dark watermark extraction task ID

WatermarkContent.description_en: The extracted watermark content. This parameter is returned only when `Status` is `succeeded` and `Detected=true`
WatermarkContent.description_zh: 提取到的水印内容。仅在 `Status` 为 `succeeded` 且 `Detected=true` 时返回
WatermarkContent.title_en: 提取到的水印内容，检测到水印时返回
WatermarkContent.title_zh: 提取到的水印内容，检测到水印时返回
